schema: Original contract and full input schema
intro: This catalog ships with this build. In a connected client, use tools/list to discover the running server’s tools. Browsing the catalog does not call them.
Este catálogo acompanha o binário desta versão. No cliente conectado, use tools/list para descobrir o que está disponível. Consultar esta página não executa ferramentas.
transfer: Transfer operations require BEE_TRANSFER_ENABLED=true and permitted administrative access.
As transferências exigem BEE_TRANSFER_ENABLED=true e acesso administrativo permitido.
empty: On an empty database, listBoards with query.limit set to 1 returns this structured content:
Em uma base vazia, listBoards com query.limit igual a 1 retorna este conteúdo estruturado:
conflict: A stale write can return a version conflict. Read the current version and reconcile the change. When retrying the same operation after a timeout, preserve the idempotency key and original request.

Uma gravação com versão antiga pode retornar conflito. Leia a versão atual e reconcilie a alteração. Para repetir a mesma operação após timeout, preserve a chave de idempotência e o conteúdo original.
resourceHelp: Use resources/list and resources/read for the bundled reference material.
Use resources/list e resources/read para consultar os materiais empacotados.
promptHelp: Discover templates with prompts/list and retrieve one with prompts/get. Templates prepare context for the client.
Descubra os modelos com prompts/list e obtenha um deles com prompts/get. Eles preparam contexto para o cliente.

special.echo_request: Echo the supplied request for a transport check.
special.exportData: Start an export of a consistent database snapshot.
special.previewDataImport: Read an existing preview for a job previously uploaded over HTTP.
special.restoreDataImport: Restore an approved package into an empty destination.
special.cancelDataTransfer: Request cancellation of a transfer job.
special.prepare_execution: Read the task, executor and plan for an upcoming execution.
special.record_progress: Record the current synthesis, progress, blocker or comment atomically.
special.close_activity: Record the activity result, evidence and optional review in one transaction.

errorExample: A stale updateAgent call returns isError with this structured content. Transfer calls on an instance with transfers disabled return transfer_disabled.
Uma chamada updateAgent com versão antiga retorna isError com este conteúdo estruturado. Chamadas de transferência com o recurso desativado retornam transfer_disabled.
